::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded by Saravana Maruthamuthu; reports place it in Chennai or Singapore with R&D in Bengaluru. Taped out a 12nm FinFET test chip at TSMC (announced February 2026, alongside a $1.8M pre-Series A led by Bluehill.VC and A99) and signed an assembly-and-test MoU with Kaynes Semicon.
:::

## What does this firm design?

The Palani platform: analog in-memory-compute NPUs and SoCs with chip-to-chip optical links for AI inference.
